text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! That was so close.
You almost had it!
choice_data_list: ...We need to think of a strategy.
...We need to think of a strategy, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that wonderful?
Having the drive to improve at anything
is always a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"If we're doing this, we might as well both improve.
A crane game master duo sounds pretty fun, doesn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And so, it's time for an immediate rematch! I'll keep you company until your wallet's completely empty♪

text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
